title: LIVE: Emergency services on Bury Road after huge explosion heard in Bamford
excerpt: All emergency services are in attendance on Bury Road, Bamford, after a huge explosion was heard in the area on Tuesday evening. More to follow.
body:
All emergency services are in attendance on Bury Road in Bamford after a huge explosion was heard in the area on Tuesday evening, 17 November.

The cause of the explosion has not been confirmed, and there is no confirmed information yet about any injuries or damage.

This story will be updated as more information becomes available.

Source: Rochdale Daily newsdesk, 17 November 2026.

live_updates.text: A huge explosion has been heard in Bamford. All emergency services are in attendance on Bury Road.
